A headerless table whose rows have different cell counts is padded, not turned into a list

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<table><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td></tr><tr><td>C</td></tr></table>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
